themes.description: Issues related to incorrect, outdated, or delayed display of financial data, such as portfolio values, transaction history, or account balances.
Suggestions for new features, improvements to existing functionalities, or feedback on the overall utility and design of the application.
Reviews related to the ease of use, user-friendliness, interface design, and overall user experience of the application.
Addresses user concerns related to financial losses or gains, the suitability of the platform for specific trading strategies, and the overall results of trading activities.
Covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall positive or negative user experience with the application interface.
This theme covers feedback related to tracking investments, portfolio performance, and the display of investment-related data.
This theme captures reviews expressing satisfaction with the app's features, services, or overall experience.
This theme covers feedback related to the overall trading functionality, effectiveness, and perceived value of the app for traders.
This theme covers issues related to the availability, fulfillment, and listing of investment products like bonds, and discrepancies in product information.
Problems related to account creation, verification (KYC), login, profile management, and general account functionality.
Issues related to account creation, deactivation, nominee changes, and other account-specific administrative processes.
Issues related to installing the application, initial setup, or compatibility problems.
Concerns or suggestions related to specific trading functionalities, order types, or market access features.
This theme covers user suggestions for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or requests for changes in product offerings.
This theme covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user interface design of the application.

General feedback regarding the overall application experience, including ease of use, design, and satisfaction.
Complaints related to significant financial losses, unexpected deductions, or perceived mismanagement of funds leading to monetary harm.
Issues concerning the accuracy, availability, or timeliness of market information and data displayed within the application.
Problems related to logging in, account recovery, password resets, or accessing account features.
This theme covers complaints or feedback related to trading rules, margin requirements, and other platform-specific policies that affect trading activities.
Covers overall positive or negative sentiment about the service or platform without specific details fitting other themes.
Issues related to account creation, KYC, Demat account setup, and initial investment processing delays.

Reviews providing feedback, complaints, or suggestions related to the application's user interface, design, and overall user experience.
